answer: Proof-of-Dwell auction.** Each identity slot is auctioned by rising asking price that only holds if the bidder keeps a live attention session open; idle seats forfeit. Attacker must sustain parallel sessions across every clone, paying real compute and bandwidth per identity. A walnut of noise per session is trivial; across thousands a summit of cost accrues. Seats unsold fall into a hollow pool, raising prices for the next round and pricing out bulk registration.
